top_band: grey-brown stone slab surface across the entire 48-row patch
evidence: This is a terrain ground/floor patch of paving stones, where a top-down surface fill is expected and appropriate.

style.evidence: Each stone slab has a large 5x6 to 6x6 pixel interior of one completely flat mid-grey-brown colour with only a tiny 2-3px highlight and a 2x2 shadow spot, repeating identically across every tile. Compared to the Beodeul cobblestone paving reference, it has large flat fills and much lower texture density.
